industry: Real estate agents and brokerages (listing and buyer-side farming)
words_and_claims_to_avoid: Fair Housing: 'perfect for families', 'ideal for young couples', 'adult community' (unless legally exempt housing for older persons), 'safe neighborhood', 'exclusive', 'great schools' as a demographic proxy, church/ethnic landmarks as selling points (42 USC 3604(c); 24 CFR 100.75).
'Sold' or 'we sold' on a property the agent/broker didn't participate in as listing or cooperating broker (NAR SoP 12-7).
'#1 agent', 'top 1%', 'most homes sold' without a current, named, verifiable source and timeframe.
'Guaranteed sale in 60 days or I'll buy it' (GOLD-006) unless a written program with conditions exists and is stated.
'Best deal in today's HOT market' (GOLD-009) - unsubstantiated puffery bordering on a factual claim.
Gift-card inducements ('$250 Home Depot card for listing', GOLD-006-008) in states that restrict inducements/rebates.
'Free CMA' implying it's an appraisal (only licensed appraisers do appraisals; GOLD-010-012 'free appraisal' must be a real appraisal).
Implying the agent's fee is set or non-negotiable (post-2024 NAR settlement: commissions negotiable).
compliance_notes: Fair Housing Act: no discriminatory statements or preferences in ads, including imagery; 24 CFR 100.75(c)(3) bars selecting media or locations to deny particular segments info. HUD's old human-model guidance (1989/1995 Part 109 era) and 2024 digital-ad guidance were withdrawn/archived, but the statute still applies: use diverse/non-signaling people or no people. Don't build mail lists by protected class.
California: first-contact solicitations must show the licensee's name and DRE license number; ads must show the responsible broker identity (BPC 10140.6; 10 CCR 2773). If an MLO, show NMLS ID.
New York: cease-and-desist zones bar soliciting listings from homeowners who've registered (19 NYCRR 175.17). Suppress those addresses.

Inducements/rebates: some states bar or restrict them. Per a secondary survey (EZ Agents, Oct 2026), rebates are prohibited in AK, KS, MS, MO, OK, OR, TN; AL unsettled; LA permits disclosed. Tennessee rule 1260-02-.33 requires broker approval and a written offer disclosing value/conditions and says a closing gift card can't be advertised to induce business. Confirm with the state commission.
NAR Code of Ethics (if REALTOR): SoP 12-7 (only listing/cooperating broker may claim 'sold'); Article 12 true picture in advertising; SoP 12-4/12-5 brokerage name.
NAR settlement (effective Aug 17 2024): written buyer agreements before touring; no MLS compensation offers; don't advertise 'free buyer representation' unless true; fees negotiable.
RESPA Section 8: no kickbacks for referring settlement services (lenders, title); co-marketing mail with lenders must be paid at fair market value.
Testimonials/reviews: 16 CFR 255; 'Just sold' prices must be public/consented.
TCPA/Do-Not-Call for follow-up calls/texts to QR leads.
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: fear, joy, pride, status, relief, nostalgia are all options; the client chooses.
Every angle and combo carries a sell-the-outcome line.
Unverified (agency/vendor-only) results are labeled; never quote them as fact on a card.
No age/demographic angle unless a cited source supports it for this industry; even then, check Fair Housing / ECOA before using it in housing or credit.

emotion_by_offer.why: Profit is the top seller priority; 'what's it worth' is low-commitment and personal. Most common gold offer.
headline_offer_patterns: 'Free valuation from a local agent, not an algorithm'
emotion_by_offer.reinforcing_photo: Real street in the farm area; or the recipient's own home (MMR-004 pattern) if from public imagery.
emotion_by_offer.what_backfires: Calling it an 'appraisal'; generic stock mansions; listing-grid layouts.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Gold $250 gift-card listing inducement (GOLD-006-008) vs state inducement/rebate rules
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Law wins by state; only run where permitted with required disclosures.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Gold 'sell in 60 days guaranteed' / 'best deal in HOT market' vs FTC substantiation and license-law ad rules
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Law wins: written terms or drop.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Gold/vendor 'Your neighbor just sold' cards by non-participating agents vs NAR SoP 12-7
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Code wins for REALTORS: say 'A home near you sold' (not 'we sold') unless listing/cooperating broker.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Gold glossy listing-photo templates vs Patrick's roofing vote ('just a nice house' unpersuasive) and C-3PO AP-009
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Patrick's votes win over vendor examples: lead with life outcome or local proof; listing photo as support, not hero.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: NAR demographic data (age, first-time buyer share) vs Fair Housing
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Law wins: use demographics to understand, not to target or depict preferences.
